source.reason: Capital on SLOPE-04 (303,104 contiguous blocks, 100% slope, hard-legal) in the snowy southeast of the realm. Slope is a preferred landform; the patch avoids cliff/ridge. Suggested anchor (grid 71,170; block 2288,5456) is ~8,800 blocks from the T2 activity seed, well clear of the 3072-block exclusion that rejected SLOPE-01 and SLOPE-05. Moderate relief (P50 73, slopeProxyP90 6, waterFrac 0) supports town hall, tavern and guard outpost anchors; SHORE-04 is adjacent (17 cells SW) and VALLEY-05 nearby (26 cells NW) for water access and satellite townlands.
